enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Remain still. Stretch legs. Turn again. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Wake briefly, turn over. Close eyes again. Remain still until alarm.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn on tap again. Wash face with soap. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Stir with whisk. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs with spatula. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Place plate on table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and checking the phone for weather and storm alerts
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt. Take shirt off hanger. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Select pants. Put on pants. Zip pants. Button pants. Select socks. Put on socks. Select shoes. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to desk. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Check weather forecast. Check storm alerts. Close weather app. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to subway station. Enter station. Swipe card. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Get off train. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record temperature. Administer medication. Talk to patient about symptoms. Review patient chart. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer to update records. Answer phone call. Consult with doctor. Walk to another patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Change wound dressing. Monitor IV drip. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk back to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to text. Finish sandwich. Stand up. Pick up tray. Return tray to counter. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient's condition. Adjust IV. Administer medication. Talk to patient's family. Walk to operating room. Scrub in. Assist in surgery. Pass instruments. Suture wound. Remove gloves. Walk to recovery room. Monitor patient. Write notes. Walk to nurses' station. Update charts. Answer calls. Walk to another patient. Provide wound care. Walk to break room.

Walk to train station. Board train. Sit down. Check phone. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Take off shoes. Hang coat. Walk to kitchen.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Chop vegetables. Season chicken. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking storm updates on the computer and charging phone and computer in case of a power outage
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Navigate to weather website. Read storm updates. Click on radar map. Check forecast. Close browser. Shut down computer. Pick up phone. Plug phone into charger. Plug computer into charger. Check battery level. Unplug other devices.

Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Massage scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk into bedroom. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on bed. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lie down. Pull blanket. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: setting the alarm and charging the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Open clock app. Set alarm for 06:30. Turn off alarm sound. Plug phone into charger. Check phone battery. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Adjust pillow. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to other side. Remain still. Move leg. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Remain still.
